pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Adoration of the Magi — the kings of distant peoples kneeling with their gifts before the Child, ascribe to the LORD O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_geslachten

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba — the queen holding out a tall golden vessel to the seated king against a ground of tooled gold, ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name, bring an offering and enter His courts
pictures.name: pd_witz_offer

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Sistine Madonna — the kneeling saints turned in worship with the curtains drawn back on the opened heaven, worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness, tremble before Him all the earth
pictures.name: pd_raphael_aanbid

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, View of Dordrecht from the Dordtse Kil — the town standing firm on its own water under an enormous quiet sky, declare among the nations the LORD reigns, the world is firmly established it cannot be moved
pictures.name: pd_goyen_wereld

pictures.scene: Riccardo Quartararo, Saint Michael the Archangel — the angel standing with the sword and the level scales held out straight, He will judge the peoples with equity
pictures.name: pd_quartararo_recht

lines.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations,
ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name;
bring an offering and enter His courts.
Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
tremble before Him, all the earth.
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!”
The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved;
He will judge the peoples with equity.
